card.name: Traditional Chinese medicine causes and organs
card.fires_on: Words in traditional Chinese medicine text that name causes or affected organs, such as wind, liver, and the linking words (to, as, by, with, and) before them. It is strongest in herbal formula descriptions for pain and headache.

modes.label: Wind and organ terms
modes.description: The TCM cause or organ word itself, like wind or liver.
modes.example: treats headaches due to<< wind>> cold.

modes.label: Linking words before causes
modes.description: Words like to, as, by, with, and that lead into a cause or pattern.
modes.example: treats headache due<< to>> wind and dampness.

card.plain: It marks herbal-medicine text that explains pain or headache by causes like wind, cold, and dampness or by weak organs.
